county-officials.summary: In 52 of Wisconsin's 72 counties the card names your board district but not the supervisor holding it, and links the county board instead.
county-officials.why: Wisconsin publishes every county's district lines in one file but no statewide roster of the people in them. Twenty counties publish a member list by district, and those names ship; the rest publish maps, PDFs, or nothing readable.
county-officials.wanted: For one of the 52 unnamed counties: a page listing each supervisory district beside the supervisor holding it. A district map, a PDF or an alphabetical list with no district column cannot be used.
